general.summary: Anthropic PBC reported nearly $17 billion of revenue for the third quarter as of Sept. 30. The artificial intelligence lab saw a twelve-fold increase versus the same period a year ago ahead of their potentially record-breaking IPO. Bloomberg’s Bailey Lipschultz and Mandeep Singh of Bloomberg Intelligence have more. (Source: Bloomberg)

US Natural Gas Falls With Oil as Hope for Iran Talks Reemerges
general.summary: US natural gas futures dropped, reversing earlier gains, as renewed hope for talks between the US and Iran caused oil and European gas prices to plunge. Those falling prices likely triggered a selloff of baskets of commodities that include US gas, even though US gas is insulated in the short-run from overseas supply shocks because of the limits of US gas export capacity.
